script_text: Stop! Pisces, the cosmos is setting off an alarm in your solar plexus today. Neptune, your ruling planet, forms a mystical trine with Jupiter in your 12th House of Secrets, amplifying your intuition to almost unbearable levels. Meanwhile, Mercury squares Uranus in your 3rd House of Communication, making every text and email feel electrically charged. In love, if you're single, a water-sign energy crosses your path around noon — trust the pull. If taken, avoid overanalyzing your partner's silence; Neptune clouds clarity in your 7th House of Marriage. Career-wise, the Sun activates your 10th House of Status, bringing unexpected recognition. A financial opportunity linked to creative work could appear, but don't sign anything before Thursday. Warning: resist the urge to escape into fantasy today — reality needs your presence, not your daydreams. Follow for tomorrow's reading where Saturn shifts gears in your wealth sector.
